headline: Roger Williams paces the CNE in wins
dek: Roger Williams lost only two matches all season, pairing fourteen wins with five draws while conceding seventeen goals across all competitions. Fifteen different players scored for the program, which collected more victories than any other CNE side.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is heavily top-loaded across the conference: Roger Williams reached 43 goals, more than Endicott, Suffolk, Johnson & Wales (R.I.), Curry, and Wentworth combined.

wire.line: Against non-conference opponents, member programs posted 21 wins, nine draws, and eighteen defeats.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: University of New England conceded 52 goals this season, more than any other CNE program, in a campaign of three wins, four draws, and twelve defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Suffolk allowed only four goals while scoring twelve across a season of four wins, one draw, and two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Western New England midfielder Tyler Lewis took 70 shots this season, turning that volume into five goals and four assists.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gordon goalkeeper Riley Calemmo made 74 saves and allowed seventeen goals, posting a 0.813 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Curry finished without a win, recording one draw and five defeats while scoring three goals and conceding twenty.

last_match.line: The defeat ended Roger Williams's winning streak, closing out an otherwise unbeaten run through conference play.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
